meta.note: Run-to-run variance: this build was run three times with the final harness. Run 2 (this table) blew up in Voyage from cycle 2 (DOM nodes 3.9k -> 173k -> 360k -> 561k, event listeners 3.3k -> 43k, heap 38.9 -> 106 MB, Voyage tab switches freezing the renderer for 13-53 s). Runs 1 and 3 stayed flat: run 1 (10 cycles) heap cycle 2 39.53 MB -> cycle 10 41.30 MB (+4.5%), DOM nodes 3846 -> 3846, listeners 3345 -> 3345; run 3 (4 cycles) heap 39.52 -> 40.53 MB, nodes 3853 -> 3853. So the leak is intermittent; a leak rule that only holds some of the time is a failure. Root cause not yet identified (needs a snapshot from a blown-up run: re-run with --heap-snapshots until it reproduces).
